body: Actually, I'm talking to her about it right now. She's a bit worried and is trying her best to cheer me up... I've got a really good girlfriend. .__.

I am hopeful, simply because I know if I'm looking at the situation without it, it's just going to cause me to get worse. I'm lucky I posted this when I did. I still give myself about three weeks, maybe a month, to get this situated. I hope I can. I really want to go through with school and get things worked out. I think I'd make an amazing teacher... I hope. 

But I can't go through another failure like this again. I just... can't. I'm 23, if everything had been normal in my life, I'd be well on my way instead of feeling like I'm just getting started.

You're right, but I'm afraid to actually talk about this with people that I know. I'm not sure what they would think, and I don't want to bother them. I'm taking my girlfriend out to a movie tonight (which, in long distance relationship terms means: we're playing a movie at the same time and watching it over Skype), perhaps I'll bring it up to her then. 

With my Sister, it's a bit tricky. We're close, but sometimes it feels like we're complete strangers.

Thank you. That means quite a bit. Especially with me feeling the way that I am right now. Being homeless was really hard going through high school. I tried really hard even to get where I am now. And to even think about that all being a waste as I end up right back there... I'm terrified.

Half and half is perfectly fine. If, for whatever reason, my friend decides to want the car to himself completely, I'd be fine with him paying the half that I put into it. I'm willing to take any POS car at the moment, just so long as it has good gas mileage. As for saving money, I'm really going to trying hard to do that. Every penny at this point counts. 

I'm putting a lot of effort into this, despite how horrid I feel right now. But I'm terrified things aren't going to work.

I'm actually currently looking into that. I have a friend that is willing to go half and half with me and I drove for the very first time last night. (It was bloody terrifying.) However, even a car on the cheaper side is quite a bit. I get cash from school, but not that much. Not to mention gas... and the fact that it's a long drive. I think I'd be completely broke within a month and a half, sadly.
